description.value:
A thrown grenade (no launcher) that hovers over its square for 3 Rounds, sweeping lasers across a 6×6m area. Anyone who starts their Turn there or crosses it must beat DV17 Evasion or Contortionist or take 4d6: no ablation, no damage to cover, ignoring armor below SP12. Its Critical Injuries roll twice; you choose. Then it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives
